identity.name: Royal Oak Selfwinding 41
identity.one_liner: The first 41mm Royal Oak — the reference that scaled the classic for the modern wrist.

narrative.story: Introduced in 2012 for the Royal Oak's 40th anniversary, the 15400ST moved the standard self-winding model from 39mm (15300) to 41mm and became the volume Royal Oak of the 2010s — the watch most people picture when they say 'Royal Oak'. Caliber 3120 with the full AP crest rotor, grande tapisserie dial in black, blue or silver.
narrative.collector_notes: The framed date window and baton handset distinguish it from the later 15500 at a glance. Boutique-edition blue dials ('Boutique' 15400) trade at a premium; bracelet stretch and over-polished bevels are the usual condition traps.
